      Prices from poe.ninja, checked every 15 minutes (poe.ninja publishes new exchange prices about once an hour); changes are calculated from our own snapshots and stay empty until enough history exists. “Traded” is the value that changed hands in chaos. Past-league prices: daily values from poe.ninja data dumps (CC BY-SA); day 1 is each league's launch day. Thin markets (very few trades) can show misleading spikes.
